card.title: Terms and Conditions
card.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll accept your apology for missing my birthday if I get first choice of Christmas dates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum already expects me Christmas Day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boxing Day, then. In exchange, I'll tell her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather you actually stopped being hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay through New Year and I'll mean it. I'll even stop mentioning the birthday to Mum.

mechanism: A treats apology acceptance, family messaging and actual hurt as concessions priced in holiday availability.
confusable: Unlike asking for reconciliation, A must bargain over the feeling itself rather than only a practical schedule.
comparison: D22-b offers sincere forgiveness for a longer stay; D22-a offers a cash discount for acknowledgment of friendship.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
